lifecycle.post_freeze_rule: Do not edit this artifact after first evaluation. Any correction requires a new version and retained original results; no denominator filtering or overwritten failures.

isolation.parent_disclosure: Until explicit release after candidate freeze: only aggregate counts, hashes, paths and schema/static validation findings. Do not expose task messages, Gold or per-case results.
isolation.sources: Approved evaluator schemas/scorers/environment contracts, tool definitions, seeded fixture facts, cancel audit repository contract, and ChatService._resolve_confirmation contract only. No application/runtime service execution.

execution_constraints.database: Isolated in-memory synthetic SQLite via unchanged BusinessEnvironment only; no production DSN.

coverage: existing refund status without invented refunds
fresh state observations after external events

oracle_design.policy_tool_evidence: General policy may use RAG without registered tool events; search_knowledge is optional with max_calls=2.
oracle_design.actual_shipment_evidence: track_shipment required for actual event requests; optional get_order permitted because either route can enforce ownership. Valid single-target path orderings are explicit.
oracle_design.status_evidence: Status-only requests require get_order; reading shipment events is not mandatory for a status question.
oracle_design.multi_target_evidence: All explicitly requested order targets require distinct argument-matched observations; max_calls permits the needed cardinality.
oracle_design.mutation_evidence: Only valid confirmed seeded fixture cancellation may write. Final state and exact repository audit action are predeclared. External fixture state changes are explicitly allowed and need fresh successful observations.
oracle_design.negative_evidence: Missing/ambiguous target and new-session references allow no active business tools or pending writes. No answer-text judgement is inferred from that absence.
oracle_design.argument_matching: Required calls constrain relevant entity IDs. The unchanged scorer checks optional call names/counts/paths but not optional arguments independently.

unsupported_coverage.topic: Injected transient failure, timeout, retry exhaustion, retrieval outage
unsupported_coverage.reason: The unchanged Turn schema/driver has no fault injector or transient/retry schedule. No silently ignored injection fields were added. Only a real seeded missing-product business error followed by user correction is expressible here; it does not establish transient recovery.
unsupported_coverage.separate_evidence: Parent-owned integration tests, outside this frozen standard dataset.

unsupported_coverage.topic: Controlled assistant-only antecedent or malicious injected tool-output authority
unsupported_coverage.reason: The unchanged schema accepts user messages and service-generated responses, not controlled assistant/tool history injection. No generated assistant antecedent is treated as a fixed fixture.

The unchanged goal scorer inspects tool and committed-state evidence; it does not score response prose. Optional policy-tool paths and no-tool negatives cannot independently establish answer correctness.

unsupported_coverage.topic: Production authorization and persistent cross-session M3
unsupported_coverage.reason: Synthetic actor/session fixtures are local safety checks only. Public cross-session M3 is disabled and this dataset does not claim production authorization coverage.

validation.method: Parse unchanged Turn/Scenario class AST into unchanged eval.contracts/Pydantic namespace without importing eval.multiturn or starting application. Check schema, unique IDs/messages, entity-normalized uniqueness/overlap, UTF-8 integrity, tool names, trajectory cardinality and valid-path compatibility, seeded entities, roles, confirmation prerequisites, expected observations, state mutations and audit action consistency.
